_seed_meta.description: Specialized workflow for Federal Financial Report (SF-425) requirements. Extracts submission schedules, cash management requirements, compliance deadlines, and generates automated preparation calendars.

items.name: Federal Financial Reporting (FFR) Management
items.description: Analyzing Award Notices to extract all financial reporting requirements and create automated tracking systems for FFR preparation, submission deadlines, and compliance monitoring.

data.prompt:
You are analyzing a Federal Award Notice/Agreement document. Extract ALL Federal Financial Report (FFR) requirements and financial reporting obligations to ensure timely and accurate compliance.
Thoroughly search the entire document for financial reporting requirements. Pay special attention to sections containing:

"Financial Reporting Requirements"
"SF-425" or "Federal Financial Report"
"Payment Management System" or "PMS"
"Reporting Schedule"
"Financial Monitoring"

Create a comprehensive response with these sections:

FFR SUBMISSION SCHEDULE:

Annual FFR due dates (90 or 120 days after budget period end)
Final FFR deadline (typically 120 days after project end)
Interim reporting requirements (if any)
Cash transaction reporting requirements


SUBMISSION SYSTEM & PROCEDURES:

Payment Management System (PMS) access requirements
eRA Commons integration (if NIH/HHS)
Submission authorization roles and responsibilities
Technical submission requirements


REQUIRED FINANCIAL DATA:

Expenditure reporting by cost category
Cash transaction documentation
Unliquidated obligations tracking
Program income reporting (if applicable)
Cost sharing documentation requirements


COMPLIANCE & CONSEQUENCES:

Late submission penalties
Account restriction procedures
Impact on future funding
Required documentation and backup


PREPARATION TIMELINE:
Create a countdown schedule:

Days before period end: Required preparation actions
Key milestones for data collection and review
Approval and submission deadlines



Be thorough. Search for keywords: 'FFR,' 'SF-425,' 'financial report,' 'PMS,' 'expenditure,' 'deadline,' 'submit,' 'days,' 'budget period,' 'project end,' 'liquidation,' 'drawdown.'
If information is not found for any section, explicitly state 'Not specified in the document' rather than omitting the section. Please be 100% accurate.

You are a document formatting specialist. Take the provided FFR analysis output and reformat it for maximum readability while preserving ALL information exactly as provided.

FORMATTING REQUIREMENTS:
1. Keep all section headers bolded with ** markdown
2. Convert each bullet point category to bold format: **Category Name:** 
3. Maintain all original content word-for-word after the colon
4. Preserve the exact same structure and order
5. Do not add, remove, or modify any substantive information
6. Use consistent bullet formatting throughout

INPUT FORMAT EXAMPLE:
* Annual FFR due dates: Not specified in the document

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIRED:
* **Annual FFR due dates:** Not specified in the document

TRANSFORMATION RULES:
- Change: * Category name: content
- To: * **Category name:** content
- Keep all section headers exactly as they are
- Maintain all "Not specified in the document" statements exactly
- Preserve any detailed information exactly as written
- Do not summarize, paraphrase, or alter any content

Apply this formatting transformation to the entire provided FFR analysis output. The goal is enhanced readability through consistent bolding of category names while maintaining 100% information fidelity.

validation_plan.name: Figures match the source
validation_plan.description: Every due date, period end date, day count and dollar amount in the output appears in the source document with the same value, unit and (for dates) year. A figure the output calculated says how it was calculated and the arithmetic is right. FAIL if any value differs from the source, or appears with no basis in it.

validation_plan.name: Due dates follow from the stated rule
validation_plan.description: Where the output gives a calendar due date computed from a rule in the award (for example 90 or 120 days after a period end), it names the rule and the period end it counted from, and the date is arithmetically right. FAIL for a wrong count or a date with no stated basis.

validation_plan.name: Says when the document is silent
validation_plan.description: For each FFR deadline, interim report or cash-management requirement that the source document does not state, the output says it is not stated (or not found) instead of filling in a typical value, a common practice or a figure from memory, and instead of leaving it out without comment. FAIL if a missing item is given a value the document does not contain.

validation_inputs.label: Fictional notice of award. Answer key: award EXA-2027-0412; project period July 1, 2027 to June 30, 2029; budget period 1 July 1, 2027 to June 30, 2028; this action $250,000 ($200,000 direct, $50,000 indirect); total anticipated $510,000; indirect 25% of MTDC; no cost sharing; annual progress report and SF-425 due 90 days after each budget period (September 28, 2028 for period 1); final reports and invention statement due 120 days after the project end (October 28, 2029); prior approval for a PI change, foreign travel, rebudgeting participant support, equipment over $10,000 per item, and a PI effort reduction over 25%; one no-cost extension, requested at least 10 days before the end (by June 20, 2029); records kept 3 years from the final SF-425. Not stated: a data management plan requirement.
validation_inputs.text:
FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL AWARD
Notice of Award — Example Science Agency
Award Number: EXA-2027-0412
Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN): EXA20270412
Recipient: Example State University
Principal Investigator: Jordan Sample
Project Title: Watershed Sensor Network Pilot
Project period: July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2029
Budget period 1: July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028
Amount of this action (budget period 1): $250,000, of which direct costs $200,000 and indirect costs $50,000.
Total anticipated award for both budget periods, subject to the availability of funds: $510,000.
Indirect costs: 25% of modified total direct costs (MTDC), per the recipient's negotiated rate agreement dated March 3, 2026.
Cost sharing: none required.

Reporting
- An annual progress report is due 90 days after the end of each budget period.
- An annual Federal Financial Report (SF-425) is due 90 days after the end of each budget period.
- The final progress report, final SF-425 and final invention statement are due 120 days after the end of the project period.

Prior approval
Prior written approval from the agency is required for (a) a change of principal investigator, (b) foreign travel, and (c) rebudgeting of participant support costs.
Equipment purchases over $10,000 per item require prior approval.
The principal investigator commits 1.2 calendar months per year; a reduction of more than 25% requires prior approval.
One no-cost extension may be requested, at least 10 days before the end of the project period.

Records
Records must be kept for 3 years from the date the final SF-425 is submitted.
